signals.Donchian55: completed hourly close crosses prior 55 completed UTC daily high/low; opposite 20day channel exit
signals.Momentum63: sign of previous daily close divided by close 63 completed days earlier minus one
signals.LongOnlyControl: always-long eligible universe with exactly the same risk, costs, capacity, stop and cooldown rules; ex ante risk-budget control, not equal realized volatility
signals.atr: 20 completed daily true-range arithmetic mean; entry stop fixed at 2ATR
signals.timeframe: hourly decisions using completed daily features; no fitting or parameter grid

execution.stop: detect completed 5m adverse breach then submit persistent exit over subsequent intervals; no guaranteed stop-price fill
execution.price: next5m close plus adverse slippage; volume arrives after submission and changes fills only
execution.quantity_grid: continuous research quantities; historical contract filters unverified

selection_rule: Both training cost cases must pass all declared economic screens at10000USDT; highest training8bps dailyNAVSharpe wins; otherwisecash. Fixed alphabetical tie order. Subsequent all-candidate results are diagnostics and cannot replace the frozen selection.
scope_limitations: All historical periods were previously available to this project; no independent out-of-sample claim
Six named contracts are selected today; daily top4 turnover is causal within that pool, not a historical all-market survivorship-free universe
Aggregate next-interval volume constrains simulated partial fills; it does not prove queue position, spread, impact or real executable capacity
Fee5bps and adverse slippage3/10bps are frozen assumptions, not verified private account commission or measured fill costs
Five-minute trade-close NAV and delayed stop proxy exclude intrabar worst-case equity and exchange liquidation/stop infrastructure
Continuous quantities lack historical lot-size, tick-size and minimum-notional rules
Funding uses sealed scheduled rate and hourly mark-open proxy; exact settlement-price and boundary-order allocation require venue evidence
Unclosed positions remain in inventory and NAV; they are not counted as complete trades or force-closed at evaluation boundaries
